description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements the 'LogNode' interface to wrap around Android's native Log utility, providing a way to route log messages through a chain of log nodes and enabling flexible log handling.
external_methods: Log.println(int priority, String tag, String msg)

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate flexible logging through a chain of log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the provided message and optional exception using Android's Log, then passes the message along the chain if applicable.
